name: Disable NVIDIA Aspm
description: Disables PCIe Active State Power Management to prevent GPU link from entering low-power states, improving latency stability.
commands: $gpus=Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController|Where-Object{$_.PNPDeviceID -like 'PCI\VEN_10DE*'}; foreach($g in $gpus){ $enum="HKLM:\SYSTEM\ControlSet001\Enum\$($g.PNPDeviceID)"; $drv=(Get-ItemProperty -Path $enum -Name Driver).Driver; $cls="HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\$drv"; New-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name 'RMEnableASPMAtLoad' -PropertyType DWord -Value 0 -Force; New-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name 'RMEnableASPMPublicBits' -PropertyType DWord -Value 0 -Force; New-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name 'RMDisableGpuASPMFlags' -PropertyType DWord -Value 3 -Force; }
revert22H2: $gpus=Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController|Where-Object{$_.PNPDeviceID -like 'PCI\VEN_10DE*'}; foreach($g in $gpus){ $enum="HKLM:\SYSTEM\ControlSet001\Enum\$($g.PNPDeviceID)"; $drv=(Get-ItemProperty -Path $enum -Name Driver).Driver; $cls="HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\$drv"; Remove-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name 'RMEnableASPMAtLoad'; Remove-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name 'RMEnableASPMPublicBits'; Remove-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name 'RMDisableGpuASPMFlags'; }
